title: White Rocks Marina

services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: Set the hook and make memories - reserve your trip with one of these experienced captains today! Captain Roger’s been fishing these waters for over 20 years, and he knows exactly where the fish are biting. With a 25-Ton Master Captain’s License, 6-Pack license, towing endorsement, and CPR certification, you’re in good hands-whether you’re new to fishing or a seasoned pro. From rockfish and mackerel to bluefish and catfish, Captain Roger will put you in the action and make sure you have a great time out on the water. Spend the day with Backlash Outdoor Adventures and find out what the fishing in Pasadena is all about! Having logged many hours on these tides, Captain Scott knows them forwards
